'''2009 Bespin Regionals Charlie Arlandson LS Rendezvous Point''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rendezvous Point|SE-L-rendezvouspoint.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Chris Arlandson
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
